svg.aria-label: When to add plasticizer: on the solvent-casting route, cast and vacuum dry to constant weight first, then add the plasticizer in the glovebox and weigh. On the solvent-free UV route, mix all liquid components and cure directly; no drying is needed and no plasticizer is lost. After adding plasticizer, do not vacuum dry for long periods.
